paite: Uain muhsit hat ahi a, zu khauh kilai hat ahi; kuapeuh huai a paikhial apil kei hi.
Kumpipa kihtakhuaina humpinelkai humham bang ahi; kuapeuh amah hihheh in ama hinna siatna ding in thil ahihkhial hi.
Mihing a ding in kinakna a kipan kidang koih zahtakhuaina ahi; himahleh mihai in kinakna abawl ding hi.
Mithadah in phavang in lei alet kei ding; huaiziak in pawltak chiang in azong dia, bangmah anei kei ding hi.
Mihing lungtang ah thupha gel tui thuk bang ahi; himahleh theihsiamna neimi in huai asuahkhe ding hi.
Mi tampi'n amah tung a siam mi atuak ding; himahleh miginom kua'n amu ding?
Midik ama muanhuaina a-om, amah nung in atate ahampha uhi.
Kumpipa vaihawmna laltutphah tung a tu in amit in gilou tengteng athehzak hi.
Kua'n, ka lungtang ka hihsiang a, ka khelhna a kipan ka siangthou, achi thei dia?
Bukna kibang lou leh tehna kibang lou, anih tuaktuak un TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi.
Naupang nangawn in athilhih in amah-le-amah akitheisak a, anasep asiangthou hia, adik hia chih.
Za thei bil leh mu thei mit, TOUPA'N anih tuaktuak un abawl hi.
Ihmut it ke'n, na genthei kha ding hi; na mit hak in, huchi in tanghou in na tai ding hi.
Aleimi in, bangmah ahi kei, bangmah ahi kei, achi; himahleh apai khit nung in, huai chiang in aki-uangsak hi.
Dangka-eng a-om, rubi suang tampi; himahleh theihsiamna mukte jewel suangmantam ahi uh.
Mikhual a dia moh khu dia kichiammi puansilh la in; mikhual numei a dia kichiam ahihleh mohkhuhna ding in len in.
Zuautheihna tanghou mihing a ding in akhum a; himahleh anung in akam suanghum in adim ding hi.
Thiltup chiteng thuhoih gel a hihkip ahi; huan pina pil in nang kidouna na bawl.
Kuapeuh tangthu gen a pai vialvial in thugukte akitheisak hi; huaiziak in kuapeuh amukte zapi a hong kithuahpih dah in.
Kuapeuh apa hiam anu hiam hamsiat, zan khomial penpen ah akhawnvak hekmial ahi ding hi.
Atung in kinohtak a gou muh theih ahi, atawpna vualzawl ahi kei ding hi.
Gilou ka thuk ding, chi ke'n; TOUPA ngak in, ama'n ahon hondam ding hi.
Bukna kibang lou TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; huan khaina kibang lou ahoih kei hi.
Mihing painate TOUPA a kipan ahi; huchi ahih chiang in bangchi in mihing in alampi atheisiam dia?
Mihing a ding in, "Asiangthou," chih mawkmawk thang ahi, huan anung a thu kan ding a thu chiam.
Kumpipa pil in migiloute ahaih a, atung uah chilna kangtalai khe apaisak hi.
Mihing lungsim TOUPA khawnvak ahi; gilpi sunglam sungnung penpen avek a zong in.
Zahngaihna leh thutak in kumpipa ahawi a; huan alaltutphah zahngaihna aletkip hi.
Tangvalte thupina ahatna uh ahi; putekte kilawmna asamkang uh ahi.
Keh zou a satna in thil hoih lou asingsiang a; satna in gilpi sunggil lamte azel hi.
